title: PACK-15 credential redemption event payload (v1)
description: Produced by epd2_credential_service.voting_credential_events.build_redemption_event. Used by voting_credential.redeemed, the single event type this shape serves. redemption_reference is an opaque string, not a UUID. It deliberately omits the continuation capability: that value is a secret handed to the client inside the isolated voting origin and is not an audit fact, so no payload validating against this schema can carry it - additionalProperties: false makes the omission structural rather than conventional.
